scope: Public exposed synthetic development annotations only
confirmationBasis: Design member’s actual report of prior teammate confirmations and adoption of the corrected labels
adjudicationMethod: AI-assisted, adopted per Design member report
ownership: Published only in Design-owned paths; DASE can consume/mirror exact files into its evaluation paths. No original role round or other owner branch is overwritten.
changeRule: Never rewrite v1. A material label/text/grouping/partition change requires a new version with rationale and affected evaluation boundary.
